series.title: Office Enemies
series.description: After a bitter breakup, the ambitious Riley Ellison is blindsided when her ex, Owen Reid, reappears after a high-stakes merger between their companies. Forced to work side by side, their rivalry turns into an unexpected connection as they discover the thin line between hate and passion.

series.title: Torn Between the Cole Brothers
series.description: After a chance encounter with the charming Cole brothers, a young woman finds herself caught between the brooding older brother and his free-spirited twin. Family loyalty and forbidden desire collide.

series.title: The Bookworm and The Billionaire
series.description: A shy librarian accidentally spills coffee on a billionaire CEO's suit — and he demands she repay him by being his personal assistant for a month. What starts as punishment becomes something neither expected.

series.title: Dear Stranger, I Love You
series.description: When a heartbroken woman starts writing anonymous love letters to cope with her divorce, they accidentally get delivered to a reclusive novelist next door. A tender romance unfolds through words on paper.

series.title: My Knockout Fake Husband
series.description: To inherit her grandmother's fortune, she needs a husband by Friday. Enter a down-on-his-luck MMA fighter who agrees to play the part — but his knockout charm makes it hard to keep things fake.

series.title: Escaping My Ex-Husband
series.description: After years in a controlling marriage, she finally breaks free — only to discover her ex-husband will stop at nothing to get her back. A gripping tale of survival, independence, and unexpected love.

series.title: Pretend We're Perfect
series.description: A social media influencer couple seems perfect online, but behind the filters their marriage is falling apart. When a leaked video threatens to expose them, they must decide: keep pretending or start being real.

series.title: Scoring My Sexy Coach
series.description: A talented soccer player on the verge of going pro gets a new coach who's young, strict, and impossibly attractive. As the championship approaches, the heat between them becomes harder to ignore.

series.title: Mrs CEO: Strictly Unprofessional!
series.description: She clawed her way to CEO of a Fortune 500 company — only to discover her new head of security is the one-night stand she can't forget. Keeping things professional was never going to work.

series.title: Revenge of the Billionaire's Maid
series.description: Fired and humiliated by a ruthless billionaire, a former maid returns five years later as the CEO of a rival company. She's back for revenge — but old feelings have a way of complicating the best-laid plans.

series.title: The Sound of Us
series.description: A deaf musician and a hearing songwriter are paired together for a prestigious music competition. Through sign language, late nights in the studio, and shared melodies, they compose the love song of a lifetime.

series.title: Marry Me by Christmas
series.description: Her dying grandmother's last wish is to see her married by Christmas. With only three weeks left, she convinces her childhood best friend to play along. Snow, mistletoe, and real feelings do the rest.

series.title: Dear Stranger, I Love You
series.description: When a heartbroken woman starts writing anonymous love letters to cope with her divorce, they accidentally get delivered to a reclusive novelist next door. A tender romance unfolds through words on paper.

series.title: Billionaire CEO VS. Mafia King
series.description: When a powerful CEO discovers his business rival is secretly the head of an underground empire, their clash over territory turns personal. Caught in the middle is the woman they both want.

series.title: Breaking My Boss' Purity Bet
series.description: Her infuriatingly attractive boss made a public vow of celibacy for a year. Her coworkers bet she can't make him break it. What starts as a game turns dangerously real for both of them.

series.title: Never Cheat On a Hidden Heiress
series.description: He thought she was a nobody when he cheated. Big mistake. She's secretly the heiress to a billion-dollar empire, and she's about to make him watch as she rises above everything he ever was.

series.title: Oops! I Married My Enemy
series.description: A wild Vegas night leads to a shocking discovery: she accidentally married the man she's hated since college. Annulment should be easy — unless the contract says they must stay married for six months.

series.title: Dear Husband, I Upgraded CEO
series.description: Dumped by her husband for not being successful enough, she transforms herself into a tech CEO within two years. Now he wants her back — but she's already found someone who loved her at her lowest.

series.title: Engaged to the Secret Billionaire
series.description: She agrees to a blind date with a seemingly average guy from a dating app. What she doesn't know: he's hiding a billion-dollar fortune, testing whether someone can love him for who he really is.

series.title: How to Fake True Love (in 2 weeks)
series.description: Two strangers make a pact to fake-date for two weeks to make their exes jealous at a destination wedding. The plan is foolproof — until real feelings show up uninvited.

series.title: I Adopted My Stolen Baby
series.description: A woman who was told her baby died at birth discovers years later that her child is alive — and has been adopted by the very family that stole her. A mother's love knows no bounds.

series.title: Keep your Ring, I'm President Now
series.description: Left at the altar by a powerful senator's son, she channels her humiliation into ambition. Years later, she's running for president — and her ex is about to find out what real power looks like.

series.title: The Virgin and The Professor
series.description: A brilliant but sheltered graduate student develops an intense connection with her charismatic literature professor. As lines blur between mentorship and desire, both risk everything for a forbidden love.

series.title: Destined for My Billionaire Soulmate
series.description: A fortune teller predicts she'll marry a billionaire within the year. She laughs it off — until she keeps running into the same mysterious man everywhere she goes. Coincidence or destiny?

series.title: The True Heiress Perfect Revenge
series.description: Switched at birth and raised in poverty, she discovers at 25 that she's the real heiress to a fashion empire. The imposter who stole her life is about to learn that the true heiress always gets her crown back.

series.title: Serving My Enemy Alpha
series.description: In a world of rival wolf packs, an omega is captured and forced to serve the alpha of her enemy clan. But the fierce alpha harbors a secret — she's his fated mate, and destiny won't be denied.
